title: Intro to agent-driven UIs
summary: How a UI described as data changes the way we build.
description: A forty minute talk on UIs as JSON specs, typed actions and replayable sessions, followed by questions.

title: Hands-on: server rendering
summary: Render pages on the server and take them over in the browser.
description: Bring a laptop. We build a page with real URLs, render it per request and watch the browser take over.

title: Friday social
summary: Drinks and demos. Very small, very few seats.
description: An informal evening for everyone who came to the talks. Only two seats, so the sold-out path is easy to see.

title: Forms and validation clinic
summary: Validate on the client and the server with one function.
description: Shared validation, progressive enhancement and what happens when JavaScript is late or missing.
